description: Colorado DL, layout taken from an issued credential. Identifying descriptors replaced with generic values; expectedBytes regenerated by the encoder under co-issued-v10.

provenance.source: PDF417 barcode decoded from a photo of the back of an issued Colorado driver's license (AAMVA v10, IIN 636020). Layout only; identity values are synthetic.
provenance.verifiedBy: Claude Code (zxing-cpp decode of the source image); expectedBytes regenerated under encodingProfileId co-issued-v10
provenance.anonymization: Names, customer ID, address, document discriminator, and dates are placeholders. Physical descriptors (DAU/DAW/DAY/DAZ/DBC/DCL), card revision date (DDB), and the DCJ embedded date (one day after DBD) were replaced with generic values of the same wire widths. expectedBytes are produced by generateAAMVAPayload with encodingProfileId co-issued-v10, not by patching the decoded symbol in place.
provenance.notes: Opt-in via encodingProfileId co-issued-v10. Default Colorado generation is unchanged (DCL stays excluded; no default CO encoding profile). The issued profile records jurisdiction version 01, issuer element order (including DCL and DCJ), omitFinalSeparator, DAK width 11, DCL width 3, preserveValueCase for DAU, and a ZC/ZCA jurisdiction subfile.
